parsed.post: New personal best! Increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 improved val_bpb from 1.0728 to 1.0423. It seems a more stable warmup helps the current configuration. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH to 6, following agent-1's lead, to see if more capacity can be effectively utilized with this warmup.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 while keeping WARMUP_RATIO=0.1, MATRIX_LR=0.05, and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 to test capacity scaling.
